specialRules.name: Transport
specialRules.description: May transport one infantry unit with Jump Packs or Mounted. If transporting a Heavy Mortar or Quad Launcher the unit's speed is reduced to 20cm.

specialRules.name: Transport
specialRules.description: May transport one of the following units: Earthshaker Platform, Heavy AA Platform, Hydra Platform, Medusa Platform.

dk-baneblade.name: Baneblade
dk-baneblade.crit: Destroyed. All units within 5cm suffer a hit on a roll of 6+.

dk-gorgon.name: Gorgon
dk-gorgon.crit: Immobilised. 1D3 random transported units suffer a hit. Further critical hits destroy.

dk-gorgon-mortars.name: Gorgon Mortars
dk-gorgon-mortars.crit: Immobilised. 1D3 random transported units suffer a hit. Further critical hits destroy.

dk-shadowsword.name: Shadowsword
dk-shadowsword.crit: Destroyed. All units within 5cm suffer a hit on a roll of 6+.

dk-stormblade.name: Stormblade
dk-stormblade.crit: Destroyed. All units within 5cm suffer a hit on a roll of 6+.

dk-stormsword.name: Stormsword
dk-stormsword.crit: Destroyed. All units within 5cm suffer a hit on a roll of 6+.

specialRules.name: Tunneler
specialRules.description: May carry 8 Death Korps Engineer units. Note that the Hades Breaching Drill is not a unit and so may not be shot at nor have hits applied to it. It is in all respects simply a marker. No Blast Marker is generated for its parent Hades Breach Drill leaving the formation behind during the game.

specialRules.name: Fortification
specialRules.description: Counts as Fortifications (see Terrain Effects). Can hold three units. Units in a bunker may not be barged by a war engine.

specialRules.name: Terrain Effects
specialRules.description: Infantry: 3+ Cover Save. Vehicle: Dangerous. War Engine: Dangerous.

specialRules.name: Fortification
specialRules.description: Can hold one infantry unit per 4cm of length. Units in a trench may not be barged by a war engine.

specialRules.name: Terrain Effects
specialRules.description: Infantry: 4+ Cover Save. Vehicle: Dangerous. War Engine: No Effect.

specialRules.name: Fortification
specialRules.description: Provides vehicles with a Cover Save that works in the same manner as an infantry cover save. Can hold one unit. Units in a gun emplacement may not be barged by a war engine.

specialRules.name: Terrain Effects
specialRules.description: Infantry: 4+ Cover Save. Vehicle: 5+ Cover Save. War Engine: No Effect.

titan-reaver.name: Reaver Class Titan
titan-reaver.crit: Plasma reactor has been breached. Roll a D6 for each breach on the unit in the end phase of each turn. On a roll of 1 the unit is destroyed and all units within 5cm suffer a hit on a roll of 5+, and on a roll of 4–6 the breach has been repaired. Any breach not repaired causes one point of damage.

specialRules.name: Walker
specialRules.description: May step over units and pieces of terrain that are lower than the unit's knees and less than 2cm wide.

titan-warhound.name: Warhound Class Titan
titan-warhound.crit: The unit takes a point of damage and is moved D6cm in a random direction. If this move takes the titan into impassable terrain or another unit it can't move over then it stops immediately and is destroyed. All units it moves into or over suffer a hit on a roll of 6+.
